name: second-brain-os
description: A personal AI assistant with a real memory. Every other second brain remembers — this one works.
author: Asadulelah
attribution: Built on the Second Brain framework by Asadulelah.

core.principle: Graceful degradation — the core runs on just Claude Code + this plugin. Everything under 'dependencies' is an optional enhancement.

recommended.name: claude-mem
recommended.unlocks: Semantic search across all past sessions, auto-injected at session start.
recommended.without_it: The wiki + MEMORY still persist everything filed — you lose automatic recall of past conversations only.

recommended.name: superpowers
recommended.unlocks: Planning, debugging, code-review, and multi-session workflow skills.
recommended.without_it: The core filing/memory loop is unaffected.

optional.name: last30days
optional.install: search the plugin marketplace / community for the last30days research engine
optional.unlocks: Engagement-scored multi-platform research (Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket...) behind /brain-research.
optional.without_it: /brain-research falls back to plain WebSearch — shallower but functional.

optional.name: obsidian skills pack (/obsidian-* commands)
optional.install: any community Obsidian-vault skills plugin providing /obsidian-health, /obsidian-synthesize, /obsidian-reconcile, /obsidian-emerge, /obsidian-recap
optional.without_it: /brain-dream skips those phases gracefully; the /brain-* phases alone are a complete cycle.

recommended.name: Notion
recommended.how: Enable the Notion connector in Claude settings, or `claude mcp add`.
recommended.unlocks: Read/sync Notion docs and tasks directly into the wiki.

recommended.name: Google Drive
recommended.how: Enable the Google Drive connector in Claude settings.
recommended.unlocks: Read/ingest Drive files directly instead of pasting them.

hooks.unlocks: Attentional context routing — HOT/WARM/COLD tiered injection of relevant vault docs per prompt.
New sessions self-collect persisted state instead of starting cold.
Keeps the live session pool fresh as the conversation moves.
Persists session state at turn end for the next session to load.

light.description: Core only — the bare brain. Already beats any filing cabinet.

loaded.description: Core + every module and enhancement wired.

vertical.description: Core + a curated set for a use-case. An edition is a manifest, not a separate build.
